post.description: Supported contract; presence does not activate a runtime route or authentication mode. Bodyless, bounded, no-store/no-ETag/no-referrer. No bearer/ambient-claim identity. Only sign-in may select where it returns: an optional X-Braid-Return-To application path, validated by the shared browser return-path rule and carried in the protected state. One exact action header. Unsafe actions require exact Origin and separate standard auth-action AF; positive sessions additionally require112 epoch AF. Session fields/fingerprint are non-authority and memory-only. Forget success means revocation-unconfirmed only.

get.summary: Complete the fixed Entra code flow.
get.description: Supported contract; presence does not activate a runtime route or authentication mode. Bodyless, bounded, no-store/no-ETag/no-referrer. No bearer/ambient-claim identity. Only sign-in may select where it returns: an optional X-Braid-Return-To application path, validated by the shared browser return-path rule and carried in the protected state. Exactly code,state,session_state,client_info,iss,error,error_description,error_uri; protected state at most 12288 characters within the unchanged 16384-byte callback query bound. No duplicates, token fields or code+error. Success only 303 to the validated return path, or '/' when sign-in named none, after acknowledged fresh issuance; failure is fixed readable401/503 HTML, never provider text.

schema.description: Same-origin application wire path; path portion at most 1024 characters. Search permits singular q (256 UTF-8 bytes after trimming) and cursor (4096 base64url characters). Retained revision field/rule fragments require projectionDerivationId and a resource ID of at most 2048 UTF-8 bytes. Percent-encoded query/fragment data is decoded once; controls, malformed escapes, unknown query keys and external paths are refused.

entraBearer.description: A Microsoft Entra v2 delegated access token for the signed-in user, sent as Authorization: Bearer. Public client applications that the deployment allowlists obtain it with the authorization-code flow with PKCE (S256) and a loopback redirect, or with the device-code flow. {tenantId} is the deployment's fixed organizational tenant. Accepted only on business routes, only when the deployment enables bearer access, and never together with Braid cookies. A refused token answers 401 with WWW-Authenticate: Bearer error="invalid_token"; a valid token without an enabled Braid binding answers 403.
